title: Kecksburg craft was bell-shaped

tellings.quote: crash. I will say that the craft at Kexsburg in the movie was incorrectly portrayed as a flying saucer when in reality it was shaped like a bell or acorn.

plain: The object said to have come down at Kecksburg, Pennsylvania, in 1965 was shaped like a bell or an acorn, not like a flying saucer. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, while pointing out that the movie he is discussing got it wrong by showing a saucer.
